name: @pipeworx/mcp-maine-code

tools.name: me_revised_statute
tools.description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Maine Revised Statutes — Maine state law — by citation. "17-A M.R.S. 201" is murder. Returns the statutory text. Keyless. Use for "what does Maine Title 17-A section 201 say" or to check a Maine statute a case relies on.

section.description: Section within the title, e.g. "201" (murder) or "2411" (OUI).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-maine-code forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the maine-code pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
